## Pull request overview

This PR fixes CI pipeline failures (#21469860180) across lint, build, and test steps by addressing missing dependencies and configuration issues.

**Changes:**
- Added missing `eslint-plugin-storybook` dev dependency to resolve lint failures (already imported in eslint.config.js)
- Fixed package name mismatch from `@objectstack/example-todo` to `@object-ui/example-todo` in MSW example
- Added exports field to examples/todo/package.json to properly expose objectstack.config.ts
- Extended pretest build chain to include `@object-ui/plugin-form` and `@object-ui/plugin-grid` packages which are used by test files

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 3 out of 4 changed files in this pull request and generated no comments.

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| package.json | Added `eslint-plugin-storybook@^0.10.2` dev dependency and extended pretest script to build plugin-form and plugin-grid packages |
| examples/todo/package.json | Added exports field to expose objectstack.config and set type to module |
| examples/msw-todo/src/mocks/browser.ts | Corrected import path from `@objectstack/example-todo` to `@object-ui/example-todo` |
| pnpm-lock.yaml | Lockfile updates reflecting new dependency and version resolutions |
